$comment: ACC v2 — the agentd v1.3.1 environment convention. Every config-schema path derives an env var and a flag mechanically; the short aliases below are the curated set (crates/agentd/src/config/v2/mod.rs ENV_ALIASES). Precedence: built-in default < config files (merged) < env < CLI flag. Prefix resolution per name: AGENTD_<NAME> beats AGENT_<NAME> beats bare <NAME>; a derived path env (AGENTD_<PATH_WITH_UNDERSCORES>) beats an alias for the same field.
derived_path_rule: config path a.b.c → env AGENTD_A_B_C (also AGENT_A_B_C, bare A_B_C) → flag --a.b.c / --a-b-c / --a_b_c. Env/flag assignment REPLACES lists and maps wholesale.

non_config_vars.AGENTD_CONFIG / AGENT_CONFIG: colon-separated config file list (only the two prefixed spellings; no bare CONFIG)
non_config_vars.AGENTD_INTELLIGENCE_TOKEN_<N> / ..._<N>_: per-endpoint credential for failover endpoint N (1-indexed; endpoint 1 uses the bare names)
non_config_vars.AGENTD_POD_NAME / AGENT_POD_NAME: Kubernetes downward API; agent.name fallback ahead of HOSTNAME
non_config_vars.AGENTD_POD_NAMESPACE / AGENTD_POD_UID /: Kubernetes downward API identity fields (AGENT_ spellings accepted)

renderer_rules.agent_name: inject AGENT_POD_NAME via fieldRef metadata.name; never hardcode agent.name across replicas (store identity fence)
renderer_rules.secrets: only {{secret:NAME}} / {{secret-file:PATH}} references in config documents; values via env/secret file mounts
renderer_rules.invocation: config via '-c <files>' in layer order; flags reserved for process intent (--metrics-addr, --drain-timeout)
